pages.title: Orbital Scan #0074
pages.text: $(bold)Subject: Acheronite Refinement$()$(br2)Acheronite shards are raw and unstable. You can't make armor out of frozen screaming crystal. Well, you $(italic)can$(), but the results are unpleasant.$(br2)The $(bold)Acheron Forge$() solves this. Geothermal heat can refine raw shards into $(bold)Refined Acheronite$() — a stable, workable material.$(br2)$(italic)This is theoretical. You're the field test. ORSA thanks you. From orbit.$()

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Heat mode needs $(bold)Y<0$() and a lit Thermal Heater or Geothermal Core within $(bold)8 blocks$(). It takes $(bold)10 seconds$() per operation.$(br2)Link any existing forge with the $(bold)Conduit Binder$() to run electrically at any height, without nearby heat. It needs the full $(bold)25 kW$() and takes about $(bold)6.67 seconds$(). No idle draw.

pages.title: Power and Heat
pages.text: Choose $(bold)Auto / Electric / Heat$() in the forge. Auto prefers grid power and falls back to valid nearby heat. Electric pauses when power is insufficient; Heat conserves electricity. Progress survives outages and mode changes.$(br2)Each operation uses $(bold)2 Shards$() or $(bold)4 Spent Lattice$(), producing one Refined Acheronite or Sealed Lattice.$(br2)Electric operation releases $(bold)6.25 kW of room heat$(). Plan cooling. Machinery noise still carries to the Blind Architect and resonance system while processing.

pages.title: Acheron Forge
pages.text: Obsidian frame, raw Acheronite Shards for the reaction matrix, Thermal Core for heating. Fire and frozen screaming crystal in one box.
